craft_notes: Sthāyin: Giving and receiving (audārya); gifts moving both ways. Dash/colon swap (brooding held, question released). Rejected: 'grub to God' rhyme — slant unneeded; dropped. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Ah, mighty this observance, God, brooding thee throughout —
therein, from Firstborn to grub, who lacks title to release?
l4.sanskrit_cite: aho mahad idaṃ karma deva tvadbhāvanātmakam ābrahmakrimi yasmin no muktaye 'dhikriyeta kaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Ah, great is this deed, O god, consisting of contemplation on you. → Contemplation on you makes all, worm to Brahmā, eligible.
c1_essence: Contemplation-deed ennobles worm to Brahmā; beginnings, middles, ends are yours on thought's road.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)

l2.plain_english: Ah, mighty is this rite, O god — thinking on you: wherein from Brahmā down to the worm, which of us lacks title to release?
